name: Self Worth
overview: Scripture reveals that true self-worth is rooted in God's intimate creation and care for each individual, as seen in Psalms 139:13 where God is acknowledged as the one who formed us in the womb. Our value is not measured by earthly riches or status but by living uprightly before God, exemplified in Proverbs 28:6. God's loving purpose for us, promising peace and hope (Jeremiah 29:11), and His personal concern for even the smallest creatures (Luke 12:6) affirm that we are precious in His sight. Furthermore, Christ's sacrificial love demonstrated in Romans 5:8 assures us of our worth despite our sin, and His invitation in Matthew 11:28 offers rest to those burdened, underscoring that our identity and value are found in Him alone.
